species.title: Root vegetable
species.description: Root vegetables are underground plant parts eaten by humans and other animals as food . In agricultural and culinary terminology, the term applies to true roots , such as taproots and root tubers , as well as non-roots such as bulbs , corms , rhizomes , and stem tubers . [ 1 ] Root vegetables are generally energy storage organs containing carbohydrates such as starches and sugars . [ 2 ]

species.title: Pyrethrum
species.native_region: Dalmatia, Croatia
species.description: Perennial daisy producing pyrethrins (0.5-2.0% in flowers), fast-acting contact insecticide. Extremely low mammalian toxicity. Degrades rapidly in sunlight, leaving no residue.

species.title: Moso Bamboo
species.native_region: China, Taiwan
species.description: Largest temperate bamboo. Tensile strength higher than steel by weight (350-500 MPa). Harvestable in 3-5 years. Culms 10-20m tall. Construction, scaffolding, paper, edible shoots.

species.title: Field Elm
species.native_region: Europe
species.description: European tree producing timber with interlocked grain that resists splitting. Traditional choice for wagon wheel hubs and water pipes. Withstands alternating wet and dry cycles.
